method: Read every Japanese paragraph250–259 and compare both source bodies and figures/captions across pagination. Existing lessons remain referenced in both fields. Source wording that conflates auto-level body/sight compensation, all back-face scales or tool appearance/performance is bounded in existing lessons. No operating procedures authored. Prior evidence remains scoped by original access limitations.

sourceVisualReview.scope: Level and instrument labelled transit, string reel, spirit-level bubble, holder/weight, square scale photograph, convex tape and aluminium/stainless/bamboo rule captions inspected. No exact model, hidden function, numerical calibration or completeness inferred from photographs. Slump gauge at boundary is already taught in building008 shared civil; no second paragraph authored. Later cutting tools not part of this batch. No source numerical table in selected entries; sqrt2 and3:4:5 checked explicitly.

freshPrimaryReferences.scope: Selected auto-level FAQ006 body: compensation follows bubble levelling; not arbitrary body self-levelling or complete manual approval.
Selected product body: rotary laser and model-specific grade/sensor support. No numerical ranges or settings adopted; image-only specification table not certified.
Selected product name and front/back scale specification demonstrate same-scale product exists; no universal rear-scale rule.
Selected polygonal surveying/total-station body: distance plus angle, known reference and optical line of sight; not full surveying standards.
